d:
Di lallantop ka salana adda laut aaya hai. jamega 22, 23 aur 24 navanbar 2024 ko dilli ke mejar dhyan chand neshnal stediyam men. 3 dinon ke lie banie adde ka hissa sirph 499 rupae men. rajistreshan ke lie par die bainar par klik kijie
The Lallantop’s Chunav Yatra has reached Pakur district of Jharkhand. Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar reached the Gopinathpur and Hariganj villages of the district because these places have suffered communal tension for the last few months. We spoke to the people living here.
